$comment: Runtime remote registry per proposal §5.2 — 'Maintain a remote registry/configuration rather than hard coding every remote URL throughout application code.' The Shell fetches this at startup instead of importing remote URLs in source. Point remoteEntry at each MFE's built remoteEntry.js once deployed. The `status` field here is just a seed value — the Shell re-verifies real reachability itself at runtime (src/registry/useMfeRegistry.ts) and overwrites this on load, so you never need to hand-flip it to 'deployed'.
